title: End-of-Day Workstation Shutdown & Screen Sleep Policies
description: Foundational IT workplace English module covering end-of-day workstation shutdown & screen sleep policies.
learning_objectives: Master professional Obligations & Checklists in enterprise IT infrastructure and cloud operations
Eliminate common Czech interference errors in end-of-day workstation shutdown & screen sleep policies
Demonstrate precision in Zero Trust architecture, ITIL incident management, and cyber governance

questions.prompt: Always make sure that you _____ the user's Active Directory password via the IT support portal to comply with IT security policy.

explanations.correct: 'make sure that you' is followed by base verb 'reset' in the present tense clause.
explanations.wrong_A: 'to reset' is ungrammatical; finite that-clause requires base verb, not infinitive with 'to'.
explanations.wrong_C: 3rd person singular 'resets' cannot agree with subject 'you'.
explanations.wrong_D: Participle 'resetting' cannot act as finite verb without auxiliary.

questions.cz_learning_point: Czech 'ujistěte se, že resetujete'. In English that-clauses with 'you', use base form: 'that you reset'.
